keyInsights.title: NEPSE Falls 5th Session — Approaching Multi-Week Support at 2720
keyInsights.body: NEPSE closed -4.00 (-0.14%) at 2724.03 — the 5th consecutive red session. Cumulative decline from Jun 4 high of 2766.78: now -42.75 points. The index is approaching the 2720 level which has been tested multiple times in the Jun 10-12 period (chart shows intraday lows touching 2715-2720 range). A break below 2720 with conviction would open the next support zone. Breadth improved slightly from Jun 11 (81/179) to today (91/167) — slight improvement but still heavily negative.
